facts.fact: Niger's President signed a decree on 8 June 2026 abolishing the Haute Autorité de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (HAPDP), ending its officials' functions from signature and transferring its missions to the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior, per the Secretariat General of Government communique.
